observations.why: Directive with operational cadence and temporal finality ('from now on') performs a settled, load-bearing instruction the speaker expects others to follow.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic identity-level equivalence stated as bedrock — no hedges, no qualifiers; the formulation itself ('is a rollback we do not actually have') treats the conviction as constitutive rather than arguable.
Restates the cadence as a settled operational parameter in a structured field — the act of recording it in a labeled field performs ratification rather than proposing it.
Assigning ownership in a structured field performs a settled, load-bearing decision — the declarative act of naming an owner ratifies the commitment.
